stages.title: Fresh SQLite database
stages.explanation: The five canonical tables begin empty.

stages.title: Manager-supplied source records
stages.explanation: Shared component meanings and employee-owned amounts are explicit. Both employees reuse local IDs safely.

stages.title: October · retained exact review
stages.explanation: E101 is held, excluded, released, then committed with its earlier exact-content approval retained.

stages.title: October · fresh review after release
stages.explanation: E102's stale review is rejected; a review at the release revision permits commit.

stages.title: November · reconciliation rejects stale basis
stages.explanation: An added deduction and revised bonus invalidate the protected draft. Cancellation is terminal.

stages.title: November · cancelled and rebuilt
stages.explanation: The replacement uses final one-time facts; the December salary version does not replace November authority.

stages.title: November · fixed snapshot policy
stages.explanation: E102 commits fixed INR 1,000 allowance after its source changes; the difference is corrected next month.
